newsitem.title: USA: Koll says wins reorganization approval.
newsitem.headline: Koll says wins reorganization approval.

text.p: Koll Real Estate Group Inc said Friday that 95 percent of its stock and bondholders approved its prepackaged plan for financial reorganization. Koll said it intends to file the plan on Monday and anticipates completing its recapitalization in roughly 45 days.
In a statement, the real estate development company said it will exchange approximately $210 million of outstanding debentures and noncontingent claims for common stock.

Koll said that once the plan is completed all corporate debt will be eliminated, resulting in a pro forma net worth of approximately $130 million as of June 30, 1997, and the preservation of approximately $200 million of tax loss carry-forwards.

Donald Koll said the company was not in default of any financial obligations. "The prepackaged plan represents the final step in restructuring the troubled Bolsa Chica Company we inherited in March 1993, when we took over management and control."

The company said it negotiated with the Nasdaq Stock Market to list the company's common stock as soon as the restructuring is completed. The company's class a common stock and series a convertible preferred stock will be delisted from the Nasdaq National Market starting on July 14. In the interim it will be traded on the Nasdaq OTC Bulliten board.
